compiled_state.title: Add audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh sourceable gate function
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Audit gates on .reconciler-phase-gate file presence OR operator comment transitioning audit state. Refuse to execute against unadvanced state with clear 'phase not advanced' message

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh as sourceable shell library exporting check_phase_gate <phase> function. Checks .reconciler-phase-gate file (tickets branch worktree) content matches requested phase, OR operator-comment marker in .reconciler-phase-gate.ops (one phase per line). On failure: print 'phase not advanced: phase=<N> gate_missing' to stderr, exit 2. On success: exit 0. When invoked directly with phase arg, behaves as CLI. Shared gate consumed by task-2/3/4/5 (Rule of Three: 4 call sites at introduction).

## Test Approach
Given no .reconciler-phase-gate; When check_phase_gate 1 invoked; Then exit 2 + stderr contains 'phase not advanced: phase=1 gate_missing'. Given .reconciler-phase-gate containing '1'; When check_phase_gate 1 invoked; Then exit 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] shellcheck + executable: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh && test -x plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh
- [ ] Missing gate returns exit 2 with diagnostic
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_missing_gate_exits_2
- [ ] Present matching gate returns exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_present_gate_exits_0
- [ ] Operator-comment marker .reconciler-phase-gate.ops returns exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_ops_marker_exits_0

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Define schemas for gate files. (a) .reconciler-phase-gate: single-line plain text containing the canonical phase name ('dry-run' | 'bootstrap-strict' | 'bootstrap-throttle' | 'live'). (b) .reconciler-phase-gate.ops: JSON Lines, one entry per line: {operator, timestamp, phase, comment}. check_phase_gate <phase> resolves match by comparing requested phase to .reconciler-phase-gate content OR scanning .reconciler-phase-gate.ops for any entry whose phase matches AND whose timestamp is newer than the previous entry. Schema co-located with audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh as a comment block at top of file.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Test file path explicit — tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh. RED test specs: (a) missing .reconciler-phase-gate → exit 2 + stderr 'phase not advanced: phase=<N> gate_missing'; (b) phase mismatch (gate='bootstrap-strict', requested 'bootstrap-throttle') → exit 2; (c) match → exit 0 silent; (d) ops marker (.reconciler-phase-gate.ops JSON Lines) phase match → exit 0; (e) malformed JSON in .ops → fail-closed exit 2 with diagnostic.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Backward-compat degradation path — absence of .reconciler-phase-gate.ops is RECOVERABLE degradation, not a failure. Behavior: (a) gate-content check on .reconciler-phase-gate proceeds normally; (b) operator-audit query against .reconciler-phase-gate.ops returns ops_log_available=false in output JSON; (c) emit WARNING (not failure) on stderr noting ops-log unavailability; (d) overall check_phase_gate exit code reflects only the gate-content match (0=match, 2=mismatch/missing-gate). Add RED test for degradation path: gate-file present + ops-file absent → exit 0 with stderr WARNING + ops_log_available=false in output.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Phase-gate file location resolution rule — gate function looks up files via: (1) $RECONCILER_PHASE_GATE_DIR if set, else (2) $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.reconciler-state/. Documented in audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh header schema block. Add RED test: gate function honors RECONCILER_PHASE_GATE_DIR env-var override (set to /tmp/test-gate; create gate file there; check_phase_gate finds it). Rationale: 5 consumer scripts (dd1/dd2/dd3/dd5 + Makefile) — missing resolution contract guarantees integration drift (implicit_assumption).
